```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| eval: false
#| message: false

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snap_year) {
  page <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(seconds = 60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_string() |>
    read_html()

  table <- page |>
    html_table(fill = TRUE) |>
    pluck(1)

  rank_title_column <- table[[which(str_detect(names(table), "Rank.*Title"))[1]]]
  rank_title_column <- str_squish(rank_title_column)

  rating_column <- table[[which(str_detect(names(table), "IMDb Rating"))[1]]]

  tooltip_text <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn.imdbRating strong[title]") |>
    html_attr("title")

  number_text <- str_match(
    tooltip_text,
    "based on ([0-9][0-9,]*) (?:votes|user ratings)"
  )[ , 2]

  tibble(
    snap_year = snap_year,
    rank = parse_number(str_extract(rank_title_column, "^\\d+")),
    title = str_remove(rank_title_column, "^\\d+\\.\\s*") |>
      str_remove("\\s*\\(\\d{4}\\)$") |>
      str_squish(),
    year = parse_number(str_extract(rank_title_column, "\\((\\d{4})\\)$",
                                 group = 1)),
    rating = as.numeric(rating_column),
    number = parse_number(number_text)
  )
}

snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)
snapshot_addresses <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

imdb_snapshots <- map2_dfr(
  snapshot_addresses,
  snapshot_years,
  fetch_imdb_snapshot
)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- readRDS("data/imdb_snapshots.rds") |>
  as_tibble()

imdb_snapshots

imdb_snapshots |>
  count(snap_year)
```

```{r}
rank_change_data <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, release_year = year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank,
              names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = abs(rank_2022 - rank_2015),
    release_decade = floor(release_year / 10) * 10
  )

rank_change_data |>
  slice_max(rank_change, n = 10) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change))

rank_change_data |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
average_rank_change_by_decade <- rank_change_data |>
  mutate(rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015) |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(
      average_rank_change < 0,
      "Improved rank",
      "Worsened rank"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  average_rank_change_by_decade,
  aes(
    x = average_rank_change,
    y = factor(release_decade),
    fill = direction
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Improved rank" = "#2C7FB8", "Worsened rank" = "#D95F0E")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Change = 2022 rank minus 2015 rank; negative values indicate improvement.",
    x = "Average rank change",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Direction",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appear in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
